title: A Cold Day
text:
Sam wakes up and looks outside. It is cold and it is raining. He puts on a warm coat and a hat. His boots are by the door.

Sam walks to school with his friend Mia. Mia wears a red scarf and blue gloves. At lunch time, the rain stops and the sun comes out. Sam takes off his coat because the day is warm now.

options: A warm coat and a hat

questions.text: How does Sam probably feel when he first looks outside?
options: Happy to go to the beach

questions.text: Why does Sam take off his coat at lunch time?
options: The sun came out and the day got warmer
He wants to give it to Mia

vocabulary.definition: a long piece of clothing you wear outside to keep warm
a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck
water that falls from the sky in drops

paragraph_translations: Сем прокидається і дивиться у вікно. Холодно, і йде дощ. Він одягає тепле пальто і капелюх. Його черевики стоять біля дверей.
Сем іде до школи зі своєю подругою Мією. Мія носить червоний шарф і сині рукавички. Під час обіду дощ припиняється і виходить сонце. Сем знімає пальто, бо тепло.
